description: Browse the Magic set catalog (cached from Scryfall, newest release first) with the user's per-set progress: card_count (total printings in the set), owned_printings (printings held as REAL cards) and proxy_only_printings (printings held only as proxies — physically present but not tournament-legal or tradeable, never counted as owned). Filter by set_type (core, expansion, masters, commander, draft_innovation, funny, starter, promo, token, …), name substring, or include_digital (default false). Use the returned set codes with set_completion. Owning another set's printing of a card does not count toward that set here.

limit.description: Default 100, max 1000 — the catalog has ~1000 sets; prefer filters

name.description: Substring of the set name, e.g. "ravnica"

name: list_sets

owned_printings.description: The set's printings the player owns as real cards

proxy_only_printings.description: Printings held only as proxies. Proxies are not real cards: never counted as owned, always said

title: List sets
